commitments.detail: Perform a thorough review of R-22 material specifications and ensure it meets the required standards.
Adjust drying temperature and time, and screw purge duration to accommodate the new resin.
Conduct first off testing on 10 units before proceeding with full production run.
Retain 50 units as samples for traceability and potential future analysis.
Notify customers of the change in material and provide them with updated lot numbers.
Ensure all production lots are properly recorded and traceable.
